info.name: provider-service
info.description:
Concepts and flow:

- Auth is delegated to the security microservice. Use the Security Auth folder to request PIN and login. The login response stores ACCESS_TOKEN for protected requests.
- This service never issues tokens. Every protected endpoint requires Authorization: Bearer <tokenApp>.
- The worker accountId must be a real security user id. Use the /me response to fill WORKER_ACCOUNT_ID (the collection does this automatically).
- Seeds include providers and cafeterias only. Workers and assignments should be created with real users.

Recommended order:
1) Security Auth: Request PIN -> Login (OTP) -> Get Me
2) Providers, Cafeterias, Workers, Assignments
